decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Design and Access Statement [dated August 2024]; Noise
Impact Assessment [Ref: 2210HA5, dated 31 October 2024]; “Purified Air” – “The Commercial
Kitchen Experts” brochure; P1-1052410 (Notes 1); P1-1152410 (Notes 2);
P1-1252410 (Notes 3); <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-01 52410 A (Location plan);<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-01 52410 A (Existing ground and first floor
plans and site plan); <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-02 52410 (Pre-existing ground and first floor
plans and site plan)<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-08 52410 Rev 1 (Existing and pre-existing rear
elevations &amp; sections);<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-09 52410 Rev 1 (Existing and pre-existing side elevations
&amp; sections); <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-03 52410 (Pre-existing front and side elevations
&amp; sections); <o:p></o:p></p><p>













</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">P1-07 52410 (Existing front and side elevations
&amp; sections)<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">The rating level of noise emitted from any plant,
machinery and equipment on the site, shall be lower than the existing
background level by at least 10 LpA.&nbsp;
Noise levels shall be determined at one metre from the boundary of the
nearest noise sensitive premises.&nbsp; The
measurements and assessments shall be made in accordance with BS
4142:2014.&nbsp; The background noise level
shall be expressed as the lowest LA90 (10 minutes) during which the plant is or
may be in operation.&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">REASON: To ensure that the development does not
result in unacceptable noise impacts on the amenities of neighbouring
occupiers.&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
description: Change of use from dry cleaners and laundrette (Use class E and Sui Generis) to café and restaurant (Use class E(b)); installation of extract duct at rear; enclosed seating are at front (retrospective)
